name: Maple Sugar Candy
description: Historical recipe from The Canadian Family Cook Book (1914). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Break the sugar into small pieces and put it into a double boiler with the milk
Put it on the stove and cook until the sugar melts
Set the inner vessel of the double boiler directly on the stove and boil, stirring constantly, until the syrup reaches the stage where a little dropped in cold water becomes brittle
Add your butter then, and when this is melted turn the syrup into greased pans
As it cools, mark it off in squares with a knife

source.author: Grace E. Denison
source.originalInstructions:
1. Break the sugar into small pieces and put it into a double boiler with the milk
2. Put it on the stove and cook until the sugar melts
3. Set the inner vessel of the double boiler directly on the stove and boil, stirring constantly, until the syrup reaches the stage where a little dropped in cold water becomes brittle
4. Add your butter then, and when this is melted turn the syrup into greased pans
5. As it cools, mark it off in squares with a knife
